headline: Qwen-Image-2.1 open-weight release adds RGBA and multi-reference image editing
summary: Qwen announced Qwen-Image-2.1 on 20 September 2026 as an open-weight text-to-image and image-editing model with a 7B-parameter visual-generation component. Its official repository lists transparent RGBA generation, editing with up to 10 reference images, local masked/annotated edits and subject extraction among the supported features. The release is available through linked model repositories. The inspected release materials do not provide matched independent evidence for the claimed quality or efficiency improvements.
